newsitem.title: POLAND: KREDYT SEEKS TO INCLUDE PBI DATA BY OCT.
newsitem.headline: KREDYT SEEKS TO INCLUDE PBI DATA BY OCT.

text.p: Polish bank Kredyt Bank SA, currently merging with Polish Investment Bank SA (PBI), wants its October earnings report to consolidate PBI data, Kredyt's president told daily Parkiet in its Wednesday edition.

"We would like our financial results for October to already appear together with PBI," Stanislaw Pacuk was quoted as saying, adding that the 1997 net profit of the new entity should approach 70 million zlotys.
Kredyt Bank, which made a 24.5-million-zloty net profit in this year's first half, has said it seeks to complete the merger by November 30 this year.
Pacuk also told the paper that his bank, which gained 32.9-percent control of Budimex after the builder merged with a subsidiary, did not seek to up its stake.
Pacuk also said the bank and minority owner Kredietbank were discussing the launch of mutual funds operating on the Polish market.
